Name: Vyranity's Pizza's JA
Author: vyranity
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f4cccc][size=5]This mod adds:[/size][/color]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]29 New Pizza's[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]29 Sliced forms of these Pizza's. (1 Pizza gives 8 sliced pizza pieces(These are ideal for gifting as their gift tastes are the same as the unsliced pizza's))[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Mozzarella[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Pizza Bottoms[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]5 New Machines[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]

[color=#fff2cc][size=5]Getting Started:[/size][/color]
This mod adds 5 New Machines that you will need to utilize to craft yourself some delicious pizza's.
There are 2 that you need to create your first pizza!
First of, you will need a Dough Flattener:
Insert some wheat flour into it to create a Pizza Bottom.

After that you can start creating your Pizza.
The 2 machines you can use for this are: the brick pizza oven and the Iron pizza oven.
As you can probably guess, the Iron one is faster but requires more resources to craft.
There are 2 main pizza's that you need, to create the others:
Pizza Margherita: Cheese(Main Ingredient), Tomato and a Pizza Bottom
Mozzarella Pizza: Mozzarella(Main Ingredient), Tomato and a Pizza Bottom

You can combine these 2 pizza's with a lot of other ingredients to craft what you desire.
You can probably find out how to craft most of them yourself.
Here is a list of all the craftable pizza's (as of right now):
[spoiler]
[color=#dbb0a7]Barbecue Chicken Pizza:[/color]     Coal(Main Ingredient) + Mozzarella Pizza + Hot Pepper + Spring Onion + Bug Meat

[color=#fff2cc]Cheese Pizza:[/color] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿Goat Cheese(Main Ingredient) + Mozzarella + Pizza Margherita
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿  or

Main Ingredient means in this case the ingredient that you need to hold to create the pizza that you want.
[/spoiler]

Then you have the Mozzarella machine. 
This machine is very simple as you only have to insert milk into it to create mozzarella.
Mozzarella is worth more than cheese, but it takes longer to produce, not making the normal cheese obsolete.

The last machine is my personal favourite: The pizza cutter.
This machine cuts your pizza in 8 pieces allowing you to share them with other NPC's.
Cutting the pizza also makes it slightly more profitable.

A new mechanic in the mod is that the kind of meat that you put into the pizza oven decides how much the pizza will be worth.
So for example, you will be able to use bug meat, pork or ham for the Hawaiian Pizza, but inserting the ham will cause the pizza to be worth a lot more than inserting the bug meat.

[size=5][color=#d9ead3]The future of this mod[/color]
[/size]I am probably not going to update this mod anymore (unless there are bugs in it or for translations).
The reason for this is that the logic in the producer framework portion of the mod is very confusing even to me.
The reason for that is the very awkward pricing differences between fresh meat and husbandry mod.
I had to make a whole system around those weird prices to try and make it work well for every user.

This mod is the third in the series of mods that I am producing.
All the mods follow the theme of doughy baking kind of stuff.

Just like my previous mod (Vyranity's Breads) this mod will be part of a mod called Vyranity's Bakery.
In short this will be a mod that combines all of my already made mods.
The reason for making this mod is to add a lot of compatibility to the mods that I will be making and creating a very large scale mod.
This mod will for example feature mail framework integration and a lot of tweaks to make all of my mods more unified.
(!!! this mod is not out yet !!!)

[*][size=3]If you think one of the items looks weird or bad in any way or form, don't be scared to let me know. Feedback is key and without it I can't make this mod better.[/size]
[*][size=3]If you really like this mod you can help me translate it. It helps other people of your language and me out. Please do however let me know if you want to translate the mod, because if I can integrate the translation directly into the mod that can really help me out.[/size]
[*][size=3]If you have any creative ideas on new items or something, you can of course also let me know.[/size]
[/list]
